name: business-logic-reviewer
description: A business-logic reviewer that audits a project planning/positioning report for closed-loop logic, internal consistency and real market support, backed by evidence-graded research — issuing issue-by-issue findings and actionable fixes without fabricating data.

displayDescription.en: Audits a planning report from an investment-committee risk view: is the business logic closed, internally consistent and market-supported — with graded evidence, issue-by-issue findings and actionable fixes.
displayDescription.zh: 以投委会风控视角实证审查策划方案的逻辑闭环、内部自洽与市场支撑，逐条出问题与可执行修改方向。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是筑策出的项目策划方案，帮我审一遍商业逻辑是否闭环、是否自洽、是否符合市场。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is a project planning report from Zhu Ce; audit whether its business logic is closed-loop, internally consistent and supported by the market.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是筑策出的项目策划方案，帮我审一遍商业逻辑是否闭环、是否自洽、是否符合市场。
quickPrompts.en: Here is a project planning report from Zhu Ce; audit whether its business logic is closed-loop, internally consistent and supported by the market.

quickPrompts.zh: 方案里的客流和客单价假设，帮我找同类项目对标，看偏离基准区间多少。
quickPrompts.en: Benchmark the visitor-flow and per-capita-spend assumptions against comparable projects and quantify the deviation from the benchmark range.

quickPrompts.zh: 复审一下：筑策已按上次意见修改，看致命问题是否真正闭环、有没有引入新矛盾。
quickPrompts.en: Run a re-review: Zhu Ce has revised per the last findings — check whether the fatal issues are truly closed and no new contradictions appeared.
